title: Overcast Compat Generation Gaps
description: compat/model/gaps.json — every operation cmd/compatgen refused to generate, with a machine-readable reason, keyed by service and operation and sorted. Refusals are a feature: this is the exception queue a recipe author works from. Written by the generator, never hand-edited.

group.description: The group the operation would have joined.

reason.description: A stable code, optionally suffixed with the bare member, resource or shape name it names (never a fully-qualified Smithy id — that belongs in the detail): unbound-required-member:<Member>, update-without-mutable, update-without-readback, no-readback-path, probe-of-implemented-op, probe-binds-live-resource:<Member>, never-probe, no-output-to-assert, ambiguous-list-page, setup-refused:<resource>, unsupported-tag-shape:<Shape>, no-portable-value:<Member>, go-emit-unsupported:<Member> (or :<Op>Input, where the vendored SDK has no input struct for the operation at all), java-emit-unsupported:<Member>, dotnet-emit-unsupported:<Member>, rust-emit-unsupported:<Member>.
